stitchPrompt: Design a desktop restaurant operations product called Delivery App Margin Truth Board for independent restaurant owners, food-truck operators, ghost kitchens, franchise managers, and hospitality accountants balancing marketplace discovery against thin margins. Users should enter menu items, in-store price, app price, commission tier, promo spend, processing fees, packaging cost, kitchen load, and repeat-customer assumptions, then calculate true contribution margin by channel, recommend direct-order nudges, and draft a transparent customer explanation. Include a menu and channel intake, commission and fee stack breakdown, true contribution margin table, promo burn simulator, direct-order incentive planner, customer price-transparency script, and weekly channel decision board. Design direction: use a field-ops aesthetic with sturdy kitchen-service cards, steel blue panels, high-legibility margin badges, tactile checklist controls, and decisive action rails so the product feels like a back-office command board for a live restaurant, not a pretty analytics vanity screen.
